svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 1,032 mm of 16 mm rod; face both ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom end: turn an M12 x 1.75 stud 12 mm long (12.0 mm diameter)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and cut the thread; leave a square, flat 16 mm shoulder.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top end: turn an M12 stud 20 mm long the same way.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spanner flats: mill two flats 13 mm across, 20 mm long, starting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The shoulders are 1,000 mm apart. Both shoulders carry every

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blow, so face them square and break the edge 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Engrave a ring every 10 mm, deeper every 100 mm, measured up from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cone point with the cone fitted (the point is 29.3 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below the bottom shoulder). This is the backup depth scale.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cone screws on the bottom stud, the anvil on the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stud; the clamp collar slides on from the top before the anvil.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: straight within 1 mm over its length when rolled on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flat bench; both studs take an M12 nut by hand.
